selection_rule: N0 (no F0), gt_px>=2000, other annotated cam; per scene 4 smallest view_distance (tie cam,obj); 5 scenes by smallest view_distance (tie scene name); pinhole_supp = next 5 pinhole scenes

arms.same: c_ini GT box as geometric prompt -> c_ini detections
arms.slot: c_ini geo_feats injected as visual_prompt_embed on the other view (registered)
arms.replace: c_ini geo_feats replace the other view's geometry-encoder output (exploratory)
arms.same_mask/slot_mask: exemplar token pooled inside the c_ini mask (normalised, object-mean fill)
arms.same_maskimg/slot_maskimg: feature grid zeroed outside the mask before the encoder
arms.same_pts/slot_pts: positive box + 8 positive interior points (farthest-point, interior >= 3 px)
arms.same_neg/slot_neg: positive box + negative tight boxes of other c_ini objects overlapping it (>= 0.01 of box area, <= 8)
arms.same_negnc/slot_negnc: as neg, skipping negatives whose box contains the target box (exploratory)
arms.same_negall/slot_negall: positive box + negative boxes of all other objects (nearest first, <= 8) (exploratory)

pts.verdict: pass: proceed to S1-E2 with the pts exemplar
pts.adopt_rule: c1 hits >= box c1 hits and c2 >= 0.7 and paired c2 hits >= box and paired median d(cand_best_iou) >= 0

neg.verdict: discard: criterion 1 (same-image exemplar, arm neg) below 0.8
neg.adopt_rule: c1 hits >= box c1 hits and c2 >= 0.7 and paired c2 hits >= box and paired median d(cand_best_iou) >= 0

summary.adoption_rule: adoptable arms ranked by paired c2 hits, then paired median d; tie -> first registered (pts); none -> box retained

verdict.verdict: pass: proceed to S1-E2 with the pts exemplar
verdict.adopt_rule: c1 hits >= box c1 hits and c2 >= 0.7 and paired c2 hits >= box and paired median d(cand_best_iou) >= 0

thresholds.autocast: none (detector path in the mainline runs without autocast)
